name: Whore
overview: The Bible sternly warns against the practice of prostitution, emphasizing its corrupting influence on individuals and society. Leviticus 19:29 and 21:9 highlight the severity of engaging in or causing others to engage in such sin, with consequences including judgment and destruction. Deuteronomy 23:17-18 forbids bringing the earnings of a prostitute into the sanctuary, underscoring that such gains are detestable to God. Proverbs 23:27 illustrates the spiritual danger of involvement with a prostitute, likening it to a deep pit leading to ruin.
